entities.summary: Chandler Catanzaro is an American former professional football player who was a placekicker in the National Football League (NFL). He was signed by the Arizona Cardinals as an undrafted free agent in 2014 and later played for the New York Jets, Tampa Bay Buccaneers, and Carolina Panthers. He played college football for the Clemson Tigers.
